text.offer: Rodric d'Stane says, "Something wakes our dead: an evil shadow mummy, deep in the mausoleum on the north side of town, behind a wooden gate. While you put the mummies back to rest, find it and slay it, and lift the curse from our honored dead!"
text.progress: The elder of Raza has requested you enter the Mausoleum on the north end of town and slay the shadow mummy that has brought a curse to the honored dead resting within. It waits behind the wooden gate at the far end: pull both levers beside it, one and then the other quickly, to open the gate. You can find weapons and armor at the blacksmith, and spell reagents at the apothecary: right-click them and choose Buy to see what they sell.
text.complete: Rodric d'Stane says, "Thank you for your assistance. You have truly helped us in our time of need. I shall share with you some of the wisdom of my years. But you are not ready for Meridian proper yet, and Raza still needs a strong arm. There is one more thing I would ask of you."
